question: _____ was an Indian educator, political activist and publisher, who is widely remembered for hoisting the Indian national flag at the Gowalia Tank Ground in Bombay during the Quit India Movement in 1942.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aruna Asaf Ali__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Aruna Asaf Ali** was born on **16th July 1909**.
 
• Her maiden name was **Aruna Ganguly**.
 
• She was an Indian educator, political activist, and publisher.
 
• She is widely remembered for participating actively in the Indian independence movement.
 
• She famously hoisted the **Indian National flag** at the **Gowalia Tank maidan** in **Bombay **during the **Quit India Movement** in **1942**.
 
• Referred to as the '**Grand Old Lady of Indian Independence.**
 
• Married to Asaf Ali<
